question: Can I splice the same Consuming Vortex onto a single spell more than once?

expected.shortAnswer: No: each individual card can be spliced only once onto any one spell, and all are revealed at once.
expected.answer: You reveal all cards you intend to splice at the same time. Each individual card can be spliced only once onto any one spell.
